results.corrected_summary: On 2026-11-10 Cursor announced that Projects, launched in September 2026, is now multiplayer. results.corrected_title: NVIDIA unveils GR00T 2 world action model, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks at CoRL 2026
results.corrected_summary: At CoRL 2026 in Austin (Nov 9-12), NVIDIA presented GR00T 2, an open world action model for dexterous manipulation, with Isaac Lab 3.0 and a developer preview of Isaac Lab-Arena. It also announced two new open benchmarks, DexBench and VABAR. NVIDIA reports GR00T 2 completed 40 of 50 evaluated tasks at least once without task-specific demonstrations; these figures are NVIDIA's own.

Two new open benchmarks: DexBench and VABAR
NVIDIA-reported: 40 of 50 tasks completed at least once without task-specific demonstrations

results.corrected_title: NY Fed survey: expectation of higher unemployment a year ahead hits highest since April 2020
results.corrected_summary: The New York Fed's October 2026 Survey of Consumer Expectations, released 2026-11-09, showed the mean probability that US unemployment will be higher a year ahead rising 1.4 points to 45.3%, the highest since April 2020. The perceived chance of job loss rose to 13.9%. This sits against a resilient labour market, with October payrolls up 165,000 and unemployment at 4.1%.
key_facts: Probability of higher unemployment a year ahead: 45.3% (+1.4 pts), highest since April 2020 (a probability, not a rate)
BLS October payrolls +165,000, unemployment 4.1% (released before the window)
